test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

L _ R T L P _ T _ P R _ L _ R T
solution:
Given:- L _ R T L P _ T _ P R _ L _ R T

By checking options and substituting accordingly:

1) P, L, R, T, P → L **P** R T, L P **L** T, **R** P R **T,** L **P** R T

2) T, P, L, R, T → L **T** R T, L P **P** T, **L** P R **R**, L **T** R T

3) T, L, P, T, R → L **T** R T, L P **L** T, **P** P R **T**, L **R** R T

4) P, R, L, T, P → L **P** R T, L P **R** T, L P R **T**, L **P** R T

 
• Option (4) is give a pattern of L P R T - L P R T - L P R T - L P R T

Hence, the correct answer is **"P, R, L, T, P".**
